title: Agency & Partnership
description: Business Associations, Weeks 1–14 (Bainbridge, Park & Rodrigues, 6th ed.), for the Dec 15 final. Covers creating an agency, actual and apparent authority, ratification and estoppel, a principal's tort liability, agents' fiduciary duties, choosing an entity, partnership formation under the UPA and RUPA, partners' rights, authority and duties, grabbing and leaving, dissociation and dissolution, loss sharing, buyout agreements, limited partnerships and LLPs, and LLCs: formation, the operating agreement, veil piercing, fiduciary duties, additional capital, expulsion and dissolution.

documents.subject: agency-and-partnership
documents.title: Agency & Partnership Outline
documents.description: Condensed exam outline of Weeks 1–14 on the Fall 2026 syllabus (Bainbridge pp. 1–200, 231–416 and 509–624), in syllabus order with each section labeled by its week. Part I covers agency: creating the relationship, authority, ratification and estoppel, tort liability, and agents' fiduciary duties. Part II covers partnerships: choosing an entity, formation, property, management, partners' fiduciary duties, grabbing and leaving and expulsion (Week 9), dissociation and dissolution under the UPA and RUPA, Kovacik loss sharing, buyout agreements, and limited partnerships, LLPs and LLLPs (Week 10). Part III covers LLCs: formation and defective formation, the operating agreement and the implied covenant (Week 11), veil piercing and fiduciary duties (Week 12), additional capital, expulsion and dissolution (Week 13), and a final-review chart comparing the entities with a checklist for using the operating agreement on the open-book part (Week 14). Rule and tip boxes throughout, and a card for every assigned case with its casebook page and class.
headings: PART I — Agency
PART II — Partnerships and Other Unincorporated Forms
PART III — Limited Liability Companies

documents.subject: agency-and-partnership
documents.title: Agency & Partnership Concept Exams
documents.description: 14 concept exams (210 questions) for the Week 10 exam, in the format of Professor Richardson's sample exam (15 five-choice questions each, with combination choices such as "B and C" and "None of the above"), but built around the rules rather than long fact patterns. The questions test the fine distinctions: the UPA (1914) against the RUPA on entity versus aggregate theory, property, liability, dissolution, and buyouts; general partnerships against LLPs, LPs, LLLPs, and LLCs on filing, control, liability, agency, and exit; the Restatement (Second) against the Restatement (Third); and which defaults a partnership or operating agreement can and cannot change. Questions 1–6 stand alone, and Questions 7–11 and 12–15 share a focus note naming the topic and statute, such as UPA dissolution, RUPA Article 7 buyouts, LLP shields, or managing an LLC. Every choice has its own explanation, and the exams cover all 14 sections of the Weeks 1–8 condensed outline. Study mode checks each answer as you pick it; Exam mode lets you answer a full exam and then grade it. Filter by exam or outline section, shuffle the questions, and retry the ones you missed.
